chargeFlex.energyFormula: final_price = 0.349 EUR/kWh + EPEX-SPOT-linked 15-minute spot component at session start
chargeFlex.spotRule: spot component changes every 15 minutes; the component at charging start applies to the full session

chargeAdhoc.exactNumericCurrentPrice: published by operator on /preise/adhoc; no stable prefix-wide constant

unblockForComplete: Runtime/source resolver must ingest the operator-published time-dependent spot/ad-hoc price at session start (or an equivalent primary public tariff payload) rather than storing a static prefix-wide kWh price.
